summary.plain: The German, Spanish and Armenian institutes that built and ran HEGRA, the cosmic-ray and gamma-ray detector complex on La Palma that tested the stereoscopic Cherenkov telescope technique later used by H.E.S.S. and MAGIC.
summary.technical: HEGRA Collaboration (author affiliations of arXiv:astro-ph/0407118: Max-Planck-Institut fuer Kernphysik Heidelberg, Max-Planck-Institut fuer Physik Munich, Universidad Complutense Madrid, Hamburg, Kiel, Wuppertal, Yerevan Physics Institute and others); operated the HEGRA air-shower and stereoscopic IACT complex at the Roque de los Muchachos from 1987 to 2002.
